item.title: NT Daily 11/18: Business Licenses Go Online, School Funding Report Delayed & Great 8 Matchups | Jefferson City News-Tribune

Join us Monday for our winter sports preview.
This episode is brought to you by MU Health Care, Hen House and Coleman Appliance.

item.title: Questions abound where Flock cameras and Missouri Sunshine Law meet
item.description:

In Missouri, the public can use the Missouri Sunshine Law to request access to certain government records, including those related to public surveillance cameras.
